bead.title: bench-pr-A3: per-cell execution loop, resume/retry, run-mode cell reports
bead.description:
PROBLEM: With dispatch + matrix expansion in place (A2), the bash runner must actually execute cells: drive harness-adapter -> task-executor, compose report.json, and resume/retry safely so a re-run does not repeat completed work or lose attribution.

ROOT CAUSE: per-cell execution and report composition live in Go (cmd/bench/matrix.go) with no shell loop; resume/retry semantics are Go-internal and not reproducible from bash.

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark run mode):
- Per-cell loop: write cell-state.json sentinel; harness-adapters/<name> command < profile.json -> command-spec.json; compose task-spec; task-executors/<name> < task-spec.json -> cell_dir/result.json; compose report.json embedding profile, command, env_redacted, fiz.txt, fiz.err, session/, model_server (from runtime-probe.sh), harbor_runner_image_digest; delete cell-state.json on clean close.
- Resume default: skip if cell_dir/report.json exists with a terminal final_status; --force-rerun ignores; --retry-invalid reruns cells with non-empty invalid_class OR an orphan cell-state.json.
- Per-cell transient retry: bounded exponential backoff for transient errors (connection refused, 5xx, EOF parse). The new attempt cell records attempt_of:; back-write superseded_by: into the prior (closed) cell — the one allowed mutation of a closed cell.

NON-SCOPE: dispatch/listing/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); adapters/image/runtime-probe (A1); Go changes/parity/deactivation (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: depends on A2 (matrix/dispatch) and A1 (adapters, harbor executor, runtime-probe). Parent fizeau-163efede. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary runs the canary and produces cells under bench/results/fiz-tools-v1/cells/; each cell report.json embeds profile, command, env_redacted, fiz.txt, fiz.err, session/. (parent AC2) Test: Test_RunProducesCells, Test_ReportShape (scripts/benchmark/test_runner_loop.bash).
2. Re-running skips cells with a terminal final_status; --force-rerun reruns them. Test: Test_ResumeSkipsTerminal (test_runner_loop.bash).
3. --retry-invalid reruns cells with non-empty invalid_class or an orphan cell-state.json. Test: Test_RetryInvalid (test_runner_loop.bash).
4. A simulated transient error yields a retry cell carrying attempt_of: with a superseded_by: back-link written into the prior cell. Test: Test_TransientRetryLinks (test_runner_loop.bash).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: Execution-loop ACs 1-4 pass, including parent AC2 (run produces cells); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
